evidence_policy: VERIFIED / SELF-REPORTED / INFERRED / UNKNOWN remain distinct; aggregate reach, impressions and impact are not claimed as verified without source evidence.
visual_policy: Real source media first; homepage dynamically projects every visually usable deep-media record except the five hero features, ranks stronger video/metric/category signals earlier, physically removes the redundant legacy frame grid, and uses an explicit source fallback instead of broken thumbnails.
corpus_policy: One reusable canonical corpus feeds life, moments, evidence, search, media and Bro Chat projections.
responsive_policy: Person-first cinematic hero, three playable social/video surfaces, then a 24-item source-linked media mosaic on mobile and desktop before deeper documentary chapters.
